newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign banks delay start of China currency trade.
newsitem.headline: Foreign banks delay start of China currency trade.

text.p: The four foreign banks authorised to do Chinese yuan business cannot start operations yet because detailed rules have not been clarified, the Business News said on Friday.

The four banks with Shanghai branches chosen earlier this week to do local currency business are the Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp, Citibank, Tokyo-Mitsubishi Bank and the Industrial Bank of Japan.
"The four banks are doing preparatory work but details for their operations have yet to be fixed so a formal start still needs time," the newspaper said.
The newspaper said that when the foreign banks started their local currency operations, the scope would be limited and would not have a great impact on local Chinese banks.
All foreign banks in China are currently restricted to doing business in foreign currency but are eager to gain a share of the huge local market for Chinese yuan deposits and loans.
